name: Jean
source:
[i]"It is my duty to educate you as much as it is to assist you."[/i]

The cordial butler of the Claude family whom Mathis sees as a brother. He is worried about Mathis's fixation on revenge against "Bourreau."

[b]Occupation:[/b] Butler

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Camille Claude (カミーユ・クロード).[/spoiler]
